reproduce: python scripts/verify_chain.py in qesis-mcp recomputes every link from the committed spine and fails if these numbers do not follow from it.
independence: Produced by a separate process from the one that appends. The link rule is reimplemented from its documented definition rather than imported from the writer, and the log is opened read-only.

source.note: The live log is not public. The spine is the committed export that makes the verdict checkable without it.
